name: artisanpack-ui/bookings
description: Appointment scheduling and booking management for Laravel — services, availability, bookings, calendar sync, and a public booking widget.

suggest.artisanpack-ui/accessibility: Derives accessible text colours for the admin screens and the public booking widget theme.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/apple: Enables the Apple/CalDAV calendar sync driver.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/cms-framework: Adds the bookings admin navigation, permissions, and settings module. The package runs standalone without it.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/forms: Enables the booking_slot custom field type and lets a form submission create a booking.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/google: Enables the Google Calendar sync driver.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/livewire-ui-components: Renders the admin and widget screens with x-artisanpack-* components. Falls back to plain HTML/DaisyUI when absent.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/media-library: Stores service and provider images. Plain image URLs are supported when absent.
suggest.artisanpack-ui/microsoft: Enables the Outlook/Microsoft 365 calendar sync driver.
